**Answer:** The country with the highest child‑mortality rate in 2021 among those that rank in the top‑5 worldwide for either all‑cause deaths or injury deaths is **Pakistan**.

---

### How we arrived at this answer

| Category | Top‑5 countries (2021, OWID) | Child‑mortality rate (under‑5 deaths per 1 000 live births, 2021) |
|----------|------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|
| **All‑cause death rate** | 1 Israel 33.4 | 3.8 |
| | 2 France 32.8 | 2.9 |
| | 3 Australia 31.4 | 2.8 |
| | 4 Germany 29.5 | 2.8 |
| | 5 Austria 29.2 | 3.0 |
| **Injury death rate** | 1 China 16.2 | 7.1 |
| | 2 United States 15.9 | 5.6 |
| | 3 Pakistan 14.8 | **70.9** |
| | 4 Canada 13.5 | 4.2 |
| | 5 South Africa 11.8 | 49.2 |

*Sources:*  

- **All‑cause and injury death rates** – OWID’s *Age‑standardized death rate by cause* dataset (2021):  
  <https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/age-standardized-death-rate-by-cause>  

- **Child‑mortality rates** – OWID’s *Under‑5 mortality* dataset (2021):  
  <https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/under-5-mortality>

Among the ten countries that appear in either of the two top‑5 lists, each has a child‑mortality figure; the highest of these figures is Pakistan’s 70.9 deaths per 1 000 live births, far exceeding all others.

---

**Conclusion:** Pakistan had the largest child‑mortality rate in 2021 among the set of countries that rank in the top five for all‑cause or injury death rates.
